title: Skill roadmap
subtitle: A personal roadmap built from the real skills in your vacancies and CV. Click the circle to mark progress — it's all saved.
nodeStatusHint: Click to change status (not started → learning → know it)

empty.title: Nothing here
empty.hint: No skills match this filter — try a different area, or turn off “Gaps only”.

practiceHint: Practice in the "Practice" tab → filter by topic.

radar.title: Skill radar
radar.subtitle: Your level against real market demand (from the stack of your added vacancies). Where your level falls short of market demand — that's a gap.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.hint: Add vacancies or analyze their stack — and the radar will show up automatically.

radar.tooFew: A radar needs at least 3 in-demand skills to be readable — add a few more vacancies with a stack.
radar.scaleNote: Both series use a 0–100 scale: your level is absolute, market demand is relative to the most-demanded skill on the chart.

tooltip.sharedTrack: Practice measured on the shared "{{cat}}" track

level.heading: Your level
level.hint: Computed from your status, solved drills, and flashcard recall. Set it yourself if you know better.
level.sharedTrack: Practice for "{{cat}}" is shared with several skills here — override the level if it doesn't fit {{tech}}.
